answer: We parameterize state verification over a cryptographic trellis using dynamic opportunity-cost bonds and zero-knowledge delay proofs to enforce non-linear collateral requirements per identity. Partitioning capital across fake identities creates an economic canyon, as subgame-perfect slashing matrices render the expected attack payoff strictly negative. As state updates complete their validation voyage across consensus epochs, honest single-identity staking converges to a unique, highly robust strict Nash equilibrium.
